cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Studenti se seznámí s moderními metodickými nástroji a manažerskými činnostmi používanými při přípravě a realizaci efektivních inovací, které jsou jedním z hlavních zdrojů zvyšování konkurenceschopnosti, komerční úspěšnosti a celkové prosperity firmy. Současně se naučí používat vybrané nástroje managementu kvality.

Quality management (allowance 14/7)

en.label: a.
en.content: Introduction - key terms, trends in development, management quality principles, selected approaches (ISO 9000, QM, TQM)

en.label: b.
en.content: Legislative framework - requirements, state intervention, accreditation and certification, voluntary activities and their support

en.label: c.
en.content: TQM - principles, ISO 9000 versus TQM approaches, sectoral standards, QM, customer orientation and improvement, a human factor in TQM, process management, quality as a factor of business success

en.label: d.
en.content: ISO - general terms, structure, demands on quality assurance in industrial businesses, service providers and in other institutions; the role of management; quality in proposals and development; quality in the purchase, procurement, operations, storage, expedition and delivery; EFQM as an alternative of ISO, criteria of European Quality Award modules (EQA).

en.label: e.
en.content: Quality service particularity - models and tools for quality evaluation
Innovation management (allowance 14/7)

en.label: a.
en.content: Introduction - key terms, innovation as a comparative advantage, innovation cycle, principles, characters, classification and sources

en.label: b.
en.content: Business culture supporting innovation - creative thinking, creativity, creativity´s development and support, development´s methods, individual and group creativity, barriers, lateral thinking, discoveries and inventions, intellectual property´s protection, knowledge management, change management

en.label: c.
en.content: Innovation management - strategic innovation management, innovation and specific innovation time progress, innovation curves, planning, preparation of innovations, target markets, innovation concept, key elements, supporting tools for innovation management, implementation, control

en.label: d.
en.content: Innovation business plan - preparation of the business plan, Business model Canvas

en.label: e.
en.content: Innovation centres - innovation centres, scientific parks, incubators for small and medium-sized entrepreneurs and their importance, successful companies examples

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Students will get acquainted with modern methodological tools and managerial activities that are used in the preparation and implementation of effective innovations, which represent one of the main sources of increasing competitiveness, commercial success and overall prosperity of the company. At the same time, a student will learn how to use selected tools in quality management.

en.content: 1.Quality management (allowance 14/7) a.Introduction - key terms, trends in development, management quality principles, selected approaches (ISO 9000, QM, TQM)b.Legislative framework - requirements, state intervention, accreditation and certification, voluntary activities and their supportc.TQM - principles, ISO 9000 versus TQM approaches, sectoral standards, QM, customer orientation and improvement, a human factor in TQM, process management, quality as a factor of business successd.ISO - general terms, structure, demands on quality assurance in industrial businesses, service providers and in other institutions; the role of management; quality in proposals and development; quality in the purchase, procurement, operations, storage, expedition and delivery; EFQM as an alternative of ISO, criteria of European Quality Award modules (EQA).e.Quality service particularity - models and tools for quality evaluation2.Innovation management (allowance 14/7) a.Introduction - key terms, innovation as a comparative advantage, innovation cycle, principles, characters, classification and sourcesb.Business culture supporting innovation - creative thinking, creativity, creativity´s development and support, development´s methods, individual and group creativity, barriers, lateral thinking, discoveries and inventions, intellectual property´s protection, knowledge management, change managementc.Innovation management - strategic innovation management, innovation and specific innovation time progress, innovation curves, planning, preparation of innovations, target markets, innovation concept, key elements, supporting tools for innovation management, implementation, controld.Innovation business plan - preparation of the business plan, Business model Canvase.Innovation centres - innovation centres, scientific parks, incubators for small and medium-sized entrepreneurs and their importance, successful companies examples
